descriptionByLocale.en:
from September or by arrangement
Tell our story.
The Resort Hof Weissbad is more than a hotel. It is a place to arrive, enjoy and feel comfortable – right in the heart of Appenzell. We want to make exactly this feeling digitally tangible every day. For this, we are looking for a creative personality with a passion for content, storytelling and social media.
These are your tasks

• You develop and implement creative social media concepts

• You produce high-quality content – reels, stories, carousels, photos and videos – for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn

• You create online marketing campaigns (Google Ads, SEO/SEA and Meta) in close cooperation with our external marketing agency and support them in implementation

• You plan, organise and accompany photo and video shoots

• You write inspiring and target group-oriented texts for social media

• You create, design and send our newsletters via Mailchimp

• You manage our social media community and take on active community management

• You maintain and further develop our image database

• You support the design of smaller printed materials such as brochures, flyers and other advertising media according to corporate identity

• You assist with administrative marketing tasks and the maintenance of our website
What we wish from you

• You bring experience in marketing – ideally in the hotel, gastronomy or tourism industry

• You have a passion for social media, trends and digital storytelling

• You have a good eye for aesthetics, design and visual language

• You have experience in creating photo, video and text content

• You have knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, InDesign), Canva as well as video editing programmes such as Premiere Pro or CapCut

• You work independently, structured and reliably

• You are creative, bring initiative and enjoy putting ideas into practice

• You are enthusiastic about hospitality and high-quality brand communication

• You have a great enthusiasm for the hotel and gastronomy industry
What we offer you

• A versatile and creative position with a lot of personal responsibility in a small team

• Plenty of room for your ideas and the opportunity to actively shape our digital presence

• An inspiring working environment in one of the most beautiful wellness and holiday hotels in Eastern Switzerland

• A warm, motivated team with short decision-making paths

• Attractive benefits and development opportunities
Do you love capturing special moments, inspiring people with images and videos and implementing ideas independently? Then we look forward to getting to know you.

As an innovative and successful company, we offer attractive employment conditions in one of the most beautiful resorts in Eastern Switzerland. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees with great team spirit.

• You prepare our seminar and event rooms according to the event order
